facts.fact: Burkina Faso's Brigade Centrale de Lutte Contre la Cybercriminalite (BCLCC) arrested a 36-year-old suspect who used AI tools to generate fake vehicle registration cards sent by WhatsApp to 14 victims (421,000 FCFA lost) and referred him to the Ouaga I prosecutor; no rule is named.
